findings.title: Operator dispatch intent is persisted as DISPATCHED
evidence: writeDispatchFact writes fact type ao_act_dispatch_v1
TASK_DISPATCH maps nextStatus to DISPATCHED
the write occurs directly in the operator action route
findings.semantic_risk: operator request is represented using the same term later used by runtime dispatch delivery
findings.required_direction: operator action must become dispatch intent/request; canonical AO-ACT runtime must own delivery/acceptance state

findings.title: AO-ACT DISPATCHED has multiple incompatible meanings
evidence: operator route writes ao_act_dispatch_v1.status=DISPATCHED
dispatch queue claim changes READY to DISPATCHED while leasing the item
executor writes DISPATCHED before adapter.execute()
executor writes ACKED only after adapter success
findings.semantic_risk: operator intent, lease/claim, and adapter-send stage are conflated
findings.required_direction: split dispatch_intent, claim/lease, send/delivery, provider acknowledgement and receipt semantics

findings.title: Agronomy Agent fabricates missing soil moisture before decision production
evidence: DEFAULT_SOIL_MOISTURE=30
missing telemetry falls back to DEFAULT_SOIL_MOISTURE
effectiveSoilMoisture is supplied to recommendation generation
the job writes decision_recommendation_v1 and can create operation_plan_v1
findings.semantic_risk: missing evidence becomes an authoritative numeric observation and can influence downstream action
findings.required_direction: shadow legacy calculator through qualified evidence; missing evidence must remain missing/unknown; remove direct OperationPlan authority after comparison

findings.title: Formal Acceptance can write fabricated field-response measurements into formal learning memory
evidence: formal acceptance may pass on formal coverage/as-applied/flow-meter/variable-zone evidence without requiring pre/post soil-moisture fields
when verdict=PASS and formal_acceptance=true, missing pre_soil_moisture falls back to 0.18
missing post_soil_moisture can fall back to 0.24
the resulting memory is written as FORMAL_FIELD_MEMORY
trust_level=FORMAL_ACCEPTED
customer_visible_memory=true
learning_eligible=true
findings.semantic_risk: missing outcome measurement is converted into fabricated numeric outcome memory and can become learning input
findings.required_direction: formal memory must use measured/qualified observation pairs or remain unknown; no numeric fallback may gain FORMAL_ACCEPTED or learning authority

findings.title: Formal Field Memory can bind unrelated latest device observations as operation outcome
evidence: POST /api/v1/field-memory/from-acceptance calls createFormalFieldMemoryFromAcceptanceV1
after acceptance/evidence/receipt observation-pair lookup misses, the service falls back to loadDeviceObservationPairV1
loadDeviceObservationPairV1 filters only tenant/project/group/field/metric and value_num
it orders device_observation_index_v1 by observed_at_ts_ms DESC and LIMIT 2
no operation_plan_id, receipt_id, acceptance occurred_at, execution interval, or causal window constrains the selected pair
the resulting pair is persisted as FORMAL_FIELD_MEMORY with FORMAL_ACCEPTED and learning_eligible=true
findings.semantic_risk: latest field observations can be misattributed as the before/after outcome of an unrelated accepted operation and enter formal learning memory
findings.required_direction: formal field-response memory must bind an observation pair causally to the accepted operation or fail closed; latest-two field fallback is forbidden

findings.title: Fertilization acceptance can mint PASS from caller-supplied zone assertions without execution evidence verification
evidence: registerCoreV1Routes unconditionally registers registerFertilizationV1Routes
POST /api/v1/fertilization/acceptance/evaluate forwards request body into FertilizationServiceV1.evaluateAcceptance
the write authorization accepts any of fields.write, prescription.write, acceptance.evaluate, or security.admin
evaluateAcceptance computes zone_results directly from input.zone_applications
receipt_id, act_task_id, operation_plan_id and as_applied_id are copied from caller input but are not loaded or verified
no AO-ACT receipt, AsExecuted record, evidence artifact, or canonical Acceptance fact is required before acceptance_status=PASS
ALL_REQUIRED_ZONES_PASS can therefore be produced from caller assertions alone
findings.semantic_risk: caller-provided execution claims can be promoted into an authoritative-looking fertilization acceptance PASS without proving execution provenance
findings.required_direction: fertilization acceptance must consume exact canonical execution evidence / receipt / AsExecuted bindings and fail closed on missing provenance; acceptance evaluation should require the dedicated acceptance authority scope

findings.title: Sampling acceptance uses latest-wins receipt/lab selection when exact source identity is not supplied
evidence: POST /api/v1/sampling/acceptance/evaluate makes import_id optional
findReceiptBySampleId selects sample_receipt_v1 by sample_id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1
findLabResultBySampleId without import_id uses the shared FIND_FACT_SQL ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1
createReceipt can append multiple receipts for the same sample_id because receipt_id is independently generated
createLabResult can append multiple imports for the same sample_id because import_id may be independently generated
the selected receipt/lab rows determine PASS/FAIL/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
findings.semantic_risk: later receipt or lab facts can silently change which evidence is treated as authoritative for sampling acceptance without an explicit exact source binding
findings.required_direction: sampling acceptance must bind exact receipt and lab-import identities (or an explicit immutable version relation) and fail closed on ambiguity; latest-wins selection is forbidden

findings.title: Formal Field Memory fabricates confidence=0.8 when no confidence evidence is supplied
evidence: recordMemoryV1 computes confidence as num(metrics.confidence) ?? 0.8
the canonical acceptance formal-memory call supplies before/after soil moisture, target range, success and acceptance_passed but no metrics.confidence
that call sets memory_lane=FORMAL_FIELD_MEMORY, trust_level=FORMAL_ACCEPTED, customer_visible_memory=true and learning_eligible=true
recordMemoryV1 persists the derived 0.8 into field_memory_v1.confidence
findings.semantic_risk: absence of confidence evidence is converted into a fabricated numeric confidence and promoted into customer-visible, learning-eligible formal memory
findings.required_direction: formal memory confidence must be provenance-bound to measured/qualified evidence or remain unknown/null and fail closed where a numeric confidence is required; arbitrary numeric defaults cannot acquire formal authority
